about.subtitle: Our Mission
about.title: A Fulfilling & Inclusive Learning Journey for Your Children
about.description: Tijanes Nours School offers a vibrant, progressive pedagogy tailored for children living in Luxembourg. We teach Arabic language mastery and Quran memorization respecting each student's pace, combining traditional methods with interactive modern media.

domain.subtitle: Our Fields
domain.title: Programs Tailored for Every Age
domain.card1_desc: Playful discovery of everyday vocabulary, nursery rhymes, auditory letter recognition, and memorization of initial surahs.
domain.card2_desc: Learning fluent reading, handwriting rules, thematic vocabulary, and fundamental bases of Arabic grammar.
domain.card3_desc: Personalized Holy Quran memorization program with rigorous and melodious application of Tajweed rules.
